book.name: Mak
book.title: Mak Jisas Krais Manö Aij u Mak kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Jisas nɨp aigöl gun al pak lun, a göm, gasɨ u nɨŋla

Pen Juda kai Pasopa ñɨn kub u abe, Bred Yɨs Halö Ñɨŋagep ñɨn kub u abe yöp ñɨn mɨhöp nöp mɨdö nɨŋöl gɨ, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, bɨ lo manö hag ñeb bɨ gau abe, Jisas nɨp aigöl gun, agamɨj ud sɨsɨ lun, dam al pak lun, a göm, anɨg gɨ gasɨ nɨŋla.
Pen gasɨ ap nɨŋöm hagla, “Pasopa ñɨn i anɨg gɨno, nɨbi bɨ iru nöp gai i uraköm, pen pen göm, hanɨp gɨ naij gɨnaböl,” a göm, arö gɨla.

Jisas ram rɨƚɨg agƚö Bedani amöm, Saimon ram u am asɨköm, nan ñɨŋeila. Bɨ Saimon anɨbu, nöd wös hapeb la u, Jisas gö, kamɨŋ la. Pen nan ñɨŋlö nɨŋöl gɨ, nɨbi ap wel haƚɨŋ aij auep mani kub raubal u, barol halö dapöm, aŋ au pa jö göm, Jisas nɨp nabɨc adö laŋ hoŋ ga.

Hoŋ gö, bɨ mɨdeila anɨb gau, rɨmnap nɨŋlö, hibur kalɨp u naij gö, kale ke hagla, “Wel anɨbu sɨkim göm, mɨ añɨ ap bɨ ap wög göm mani udnab rö u udöm me, nɨbi bɨ nan mɨdagöp gau kalɨp ñeb u pen nɨhön gɨnɨg anɨg göl yɨharɨŋ hoŋ göp?” ö gɨla. Anɨg hagöm, nɨbi anɨbu nɨp hag jula.
Anɨg hageila, Jisas kalɨp haga, “Nɨhön gɨnɨg anɨg hagabim? Nɨp arö gim! Yɨp göp anɨbu, gɨ aij yabɨƚ göp.
Nɨbi bɨ nan mɨdagöp gau, kale aip pör nöp mɨdeinabim rö, ñɨn rɨmnap kalɨp nan ñɨnɨg, ñɨnabim. Pen yad aip pör mɨdageinabun.
Nɨbi anɨbi, nan nɨpe gep rö u, göp. Umnö, wel haƚɨŋ aij auep u lɨ ñöm rɨgöl gɨnaböl rö, yɨp nöd lɨ ñab.
Anɨb u, yad kalöp nɨŋö hagabin, hainö manö aij yad u ram mɨnöŋ gau gau magöŋhalö hag ñɨlö arö nɨŋöl gɨ, nɨpe göp anɨbu halö haglö, kale nɨbi anɨbi nɨp gasɨ hauƚ gagnaböl,” a ga.
Judas, Jisas nɨp al pak lɨlaŋ, a göm, mumug ga
Pen Jisas bɨ nɨpe ap Judas Iskariod, Jisas nɨp mumug gɨnam a göm, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau ara.

Bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub anɨb gau, mumug ga anɨbu nɨŋöm, aij gö, hagla, “Nöp mani rɨmnap ñɨnabun,” a gɨla. Hageila me, Judas, “Aigöl gem hagnö, kale apöm Jisas nɨp ud aröl,” a göm, gasɨ u uƚhai nɨŋ mɨdeia.
Pasopa ñɨn u mɨñi, a göm, nan ñɨŋla
Bred Yɨs Halö Ñɨŋagep ñɨn kub u auö, Pasopa kaj sipsip pi pak sabe gɨ ñɨŋeb ñɨn u, Jisas bɨ nɨpe gau nɨp hag nɨŋöm hagla, “Nan hon ñɨŋnabun u, mɨgan mai gɨ jɨn gun?” ö gɨla.
Hageila, Jisas bɨ nɨpe mɨhöp hag yuöm haga, “Kale daun kub u ammil nɨŋnabil, bɨ ap ñɨg mɨl dap areinab; nɨp nable pakmil aip armil.
Bɨ anɨbu amöm ram raul arainɨm, kale mɨhöŋ bɨ ram anɨbu nap nɨbö u nɨp hag nɨŋmil hagmil, ‘Manö hag ñeb bɨ hagöp, “Bɨ yad gau aip Pasopa nan ñɨŋnabun raul mɨgan mai?” ö göp,’ a gɨmil.
Kale hag nɨŋlö, nɨpe kale dam ram adö laŋ, nan gau magöŋhalö mɨdöp raul mɨgan kub u yamnab. Yamö, nan ñɨŋnabun u raul mɨgan anɨbu gɨ jɨn gaimil,” a ga.
Jisas kalɨp mɨhöŋ anɨg hag yuö, daun kub u ammil nɨŋlö, Jisas haga rö nöp mɨdeia. Nɨŋmil, Pasopa nan ñɨŋnɨg gɨla u, gɨ jɨn gɨlö.
Dugo magö u, Jisas bɨ nɨpe rɨmnap aip amjaköm,
nan ñɨŋöl gɨ haga, “Yad kalöp nɨŋö hagabin, bɨ yad aip nan jɨm ñöl ñɨŋabun aui nöp, bɨ ap, yɨp al pak lɨlaŋ, a göm, yɨp mumug gɨnab,” a ga.
Anɨg hagö, bɨ nɨpe gau mög gö, gasɨ mɨŋör nɨŋöl göm, nɨp añɨ añɨ hag nɨŋöl gɨ hagla, “Ne yɨp hagabön aka?” gɨla.
Hageila, Jisas haga, “Kale bɨ yad unbö mɨgan laŋ mɨdpim u, bɨ ap anɨg gɨnab. Bɨ anɨbu me, yad aip nan kɨnaŋ añɨ jɨm ñöl ñɨŋabul i.
Yad Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe, God Manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm hagla rö nöp umnabin u pen bɨ yɨp al pak lɨlaŋ, a göm, mumug gɨnab u, nɨp mög nɨŋabin. Nɨpe ilön kub udnab u me, nɨp yag dauagblap u aij,” a ga.
Jisas bɨ nɨpe gau kalɨp bred wain ña
Nan ñɨŋöl gɨ, Jisas bred u udöm, God nɨp aij, a göm, ud jö göm, bɨ nɨpe gau kalɨp ñöl gɨ haga, “Ud ñɨŋim! U hañ romaŋ yad,” a ga.
Pen ñɨg wain kap u, u rö nöp udöm, God nɨp aij, a göm, bɨ nɨpe gau kalɨp ñö, magöŋhalö ñɨŋlö nɨŋöl gɨ, haga,
“Ñɨg i, hagape yad. Hagape yad hoŋ gɨ lugnab u me, God manö nɨŋö hag la rö, nɨbi bɨ iru nöp nɨpe aip ud dɨm ñɨnab,” a ga.

Anɨg hagöm haga, “Yad kalöp nɨŋö hagabin, mɨñi ñɨn i rɨköm ñɨg wain ñɨŋagnabin. Yɨharɨŋ nöp mɨdnö mɨdnö, God nɨbi bɨ udöm kumi kabö adö laŋ au abad mɨdeinab ñɨn u nöp, ñɨg wain kauyaŋ ñɨŋnabin,” a ga.
Anɨg hagöm, bɨ nɨpe gau aip God nɨp sabe gep kɨmap ap hagöm, Olip Dum arla.
Jisas Pida nɨp haga, “‘Yad Jisas nɨp nɨŋagpin,’ a gɨnabön,” a ga

Jisas bɨ nɨpe gau kalɨp haga, “God Manö u kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm hagla, ‘God nɨpe haga, “Yad bɨ kaj sipsip mukep u nɨp pak lɨnö, kaj sipsip gau pɨñɨŋ gɨ ke ke arnaböl,” a ga,’ a gɨla. Anɨb u rö, mɨdö mɨdö kale magöŋhalö yɨp arö gɨmim, pɨñɨŋ gɨ arnabim.
Pen yad umem, urakem ram mɨnöŋ Galili arnö, kale hain nɨnabim,” a ga.
Anɨg hageia, Pida haga, “Bɨ rɨmnap nöp arö göl rö löp u pen yad nöp arö gagnabin, wasö,” ga.
Hageia, Jisas haga, “Yad nöp nɨŋö hagabin, mɨñi ñɨn i nöp, sɨbön aŋ yaŋ kɨƚakɨƚ wɨñ mɨhöp alagnab magö u, ‘Yad Jisas nɨp nɨŋagpin,’ a gɨmön, ij mɨhau nɨgaŋ wai ñɨnabön,” a ga.
Hageia, Pida manö kƚö yabɨƚ hagöm haga, “Yɨp nöp aip al pak lɨnɨg, al pak löl u pen yad Jisas nɨp nɨŋagpin, a gem, hagagnabin,” a ga. Jisas bɨ nɨpe gau magöŋhalö, Pida haga rö nöp hagla.
Jisas God nɨp sabe gɨ mɨdeia
Jisas bɨ nɨpe gau aip mab wög adɨŋ Gedsemani amöm kalɨp haga, “Kale aui asɨk mɨdaimim; yad am sabe gɨnɨg arabin,” a ga.
Anɨg hagöm, Pida, Jems, Jon kalɨp uɫ gɨ damöm, gasɨ mɨlö löl gɨ haga,
“Mɨdmagö yad u ilön gɨ dam lugöp u, umnam rö löp. Kale iƚ i mɨdmim, nɨŋ mɨdaimim,” a ga.
Anɨg hagöm, kalɨp au hag löm, nɨpe yöp söl anɨb au amöm, mɨnöŋ naböŋ yaŋ lug paköm, ilön kub udnɨg geia anɨbu, Nap nɨpe wasö gɨnɨm aka wasö gagnɨm, a göm, sabe göl gɨ mɨdeia.

Nap nɨp sabe göm haga, “Bapi, ne nan gau magöŋhalö gep u nöp mɨdöp. Nan yɨp gɨnɨg gab u, yad mɨŋör kub mɨdöp. Ne yau a gɨmön, yɨp unbö gagnɨm. Pen nan yɨp nɨhön gɨnɨg gainɨm u, gasɨ yad nɨŋnam rö gagmön, gasɨ ne ke nɨŋban adö u nöp yɨp gɨmön,” a ga.
Hagöm, ado gɨ bɨ nɨpe mɨhau nɨgaŋ mɨdeila au apöm nɨŋa, kale böŋ nöp hon han arla. Anɨb u, nɨpe Pida nɨp haga, “Saimon, ai gɨnɨg gɨmön hon hanabön? Yöp magö ap nɨŋ mɨdaimön rö lagöp ar?” a ga.
Anɨg hagöm, bɨ nɨpe gau kalɨp haga, “Hon nan naij gun rö löp, a gɨmim, nɨŋ aij gɨmim, God nɨp sabe göl gɨ mɨdaimim. Gasɨ kale u gɨmim rö löp u pen hañ romaŋ kale iru maru göp,” a ga.
Anɨg hagöm, kauyaŋ ado gɨ amöm, Nap nɨp nöd sabe ga rö, kauyaŋ sabe ga.
Pen kauyaŋ ado gɨ apöm nɨŋa, bɨ nɨpe gau böŋ nöp hon kal auö han arla. Nɨŋöm, kalɨp haga, “Kale hon hanabim ar?” a ga. Hagö, ana udöm, pen hagöl rö laga.
Pen Jisas gɨsön amöm, ado gɨ apöm kauyaŋ hon haneila u nɨŋöm haga, “Kale yɨharɨŋ han mɨdpim ar? Me aij! Bɨ game, nɨŋim! Bɨ ap apöm, Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe kain göm, bɨ nan si nan naij gɨpal gau kalɨp ñɨnɨg gab.
Urakpe arun! Nɨŋim! Bɨ yɨp kain göp auab i,” a ga.
Jisas nɨp ud sɨsɨ lɨla

Jisas kalɨp manö anɨbu hagö nɨŋöl gɨ, magö anɨbu nöp, bɨ nɨpe unbö mɨgan laŋ ap, Judas, bɨ iru nöp dapöm apjaka. Bɨ anɨb gau, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, bɨ lo manö hag ñeb gau abe, bɨ manö ud asɨkep gau abe, hag yulö aula. Kale ru mɨlö kɨd rɨmnap udöm, ur pakep rɨmnap udöm, aula.
Judas nöd kalɨp hag löm haga, “Yad bɨ ap nɨp am hag wɨhai udem, ud bom haluem, mulu ñɨŋeinam u, bɨ u me, a gɨmim, nɨp ud sɨsɨ lɨmim, ud arim,” a ga.
Judas anɨg hagöm, Jisas mɨdeia au amjaköm, “Manö hag ñeb bɨ,” a göm, nɨp ud bom haluö nɨŋöl gɨ,
bɨ rɨmnap apöm, Jisas nɨp ud sɨsɨ lɨla.
Jisas ud sɨsɨ lɨlö nɨŋöl gɨ, Jisas bɨ nɨpe ap uraköm, ru mɨlö kɨd nɨpe u ud ɫɨp gɨ udöm, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub yabɨƚ u wög nɨp gɨ ñɨmɨdöp bɨ u, nɨp rɨmɨd böŋ lap u böŋ nöp rɨb ajaŋ al yua.
Pen Jisas bɨ nɨp ud sɨsɨ lɨla gau kalɨp haga, “Ru mɨlö kɨd udmim, ur pakep udmim, yɨp nan si udep bɨ ap a gɨmim auabim aka?
Yad pör pör God sabe gep ram u amem, kale aip mɨdem, nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp manö hag ñɨmɨdin u pen yɨp ud sɨsɨ lagpe. Pen uri kale God Manö u kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm hagla rö nöp gabim,” a ga.
Pen magö anɨbu nöp, Jisas bɨ nɨpe gau magöŋhalö nɨp arö göm pɨñɨŋ gɨ aram hakla.
Bɨ praj ap, waƚɨj mɨlöbö ap nöp yɨmöm, Jisas nɨp ud areila u hain arö, nɨp abe ud sɨsɨ lun, a gɨlö,
pɨrɨk areia, waƚɨj bad nɨpe u ud ju udlö, nɨpe magö nöp pɨrɨk ara.
Jisas nɨp manö kub hagla
Jisas nɨp dam, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub yabɨƚ ram u arla. Ud areila, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau löm, bɨ manö ud asɨkep gau löm, bɨ lo manö hag ñeb bɨ gau löm, ap ram anɨbu magum gɨla.
Pida pen hapi hapi nɨŋ damöm, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub yabɨƚ ram nɨpe u amjaköm, bɨ ram anɨbu wög gɨmɨdal gau aip asɨköm, mab mali mɨdeila.
Bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, Juda Kansol kub bɨ gau magöŋhalö abe, Jisas gɨ ajmɨdöp manö iƚ ap udun, nɨp al pak lun, a gɨ nɨŋ wasö nɨŋla.
Nɨbi bɨ iru nöp daulö, Jisas nɨp manö piral adö rɨmnap hagla u pen manö hagla u adɨp adɨp hagagla. Ke ke haglö, manö iƚ rɨmnap nɨŋagla.
Pen rɨmnap uraköm, piral hagöm, hagla,
“Hon nɨŋ mɨdno, nɨpe haga, ‘God sabe gep ram, ñɨmagö udöm gɨla i, rɨb waƚ gɨ yuem, ñɨn mɨhau nɨgaŋ u, kauyaŋ gɨnabin. Ñɨmagö udöm gɨpal rö u gagnabin; ram anɨbu ke yabɨƚ ap gɨnabin,’ a göp,” a gɨla.
Manö hagla anɨbu u rö nöp adɨp adɨp hagagla; ke ke hagla.
Bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub yabɨƚ u uraköm, Jisas nɨp haga, “Manö nöp hagaböl u, ne manö pen ap hagagnabön ar?” a ga.
Hagö, Jisas manö ap pen hagagö, kauyaŋ hag nɨŋöm haga, “Ne me Mesaia u, Bɨ Kub aij u Ñɨ nɨpe aka?” ga.
Hageia, Jisas haga, “Yau me. Me yad nöp. Yad, Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe, Bɨ Kub kƚö ke yabɨƚ ñɨmagö yɨjɨg kɨd lau adö asɨk mɨd arö gem, kumi kabö adö laŋ au nɨbö kumi bad aŋ aŋ lem aueinabin, nɨŋnabim,” a ga.

Jisas anɨg hagö, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub yabɨƚ u, waƚɨj nɨpe gau ke ud bɨƚɨƚɨ göl gɨ haga, “Nɨpe God hib nɨpe u rɨb juajɨp u nɨŋbim! Anɨb u, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap hag nɨŋagun. Nɨpe gɨ naij göp u waiö hagöp me u. Anɨb u, kale nɨhön gasɨ nɨŋabim?” ö ga. Hagö, bɨ kub gau magöŋhalö uraköm, hagla, “Bɨ anɨg göl hagöp anɨbu, nɨp al pak lep,” a gɨla.

Anɨg hagöm, bɨ rɨmnap Jisas nɨp kɨñu alöm, waƚɨj bad ap ud amgö nɨp u paƚu gɨ ñöm, nɨp paköl gɨ hagla, “Ne ke nɨŋmön, hanɨp hagö, nɨŋun, nöp an pakab?” ö gɨla. God sabe gep ram bɨ polisman gau, u rö nöp nɨp mɨñu magö nöp pakla.
Pida haga, “Yad Jisas nɨp nɨŋagpin,” a ga
Pida am asɨka au nöp mɨdö nɨŋöl gɨ, nɨbi praj ap, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub yabɨƚ u nɨp wög gɨ ñɨmɨdöp ap apjaköm,
Pida mab run naböŋ mɨdeia au nɨŋöm, haga, “Ne u rö nöp Jisas bɨ Nasared nɨbö u aip ajmɨdan,” a ga.
Hageia, Pida haga, “Ne nɨhön hagabön? Manö hagabön u yad nɨŋagpin,” a ga. Anɨg hagöm, höŋ yaŋ arö nɨŋöl gɨ, kɨƚakɨƚ wɨñ ala.
Nɨbi praj anɨbu nöp, Pida nɨp kauyaŋ nɨŋöm, nɨbi bɨ mɨdeila gau kalɨp haga, “Bɨ i bɨ nɨpe ap,” a ga.
Hageia, Pida kauyaŋ wasö ga. Yöp magö ap mɨdöm, nɨbi bɨ urak mɨdeila anɨb gau, Pida nɨp kauyaŋ hagla, “Ne u rö nöp ram mɨnöŋ Galili nɨbö u me, hon nɨŋbun ne abe bɨ nɨpe ap,” a gɨla.
Hageila, Pida haga, “Bɨ Kub nɨŋ mɨdöp; piral hagnö, yɨp al pak lɨnɨm. Pen nɨŋö yabɨƚ hagabin! Bɨ anɨg hagabim u yad nɨŋagpin yabɨƚ!” a ga.

Anɨg hagö nɨŋöl gɨ, kɨƚakɨƚ u kauyaŋ wɨñ ala. Wɨñ alö, Pida Jisas nöd haga, “Kɨƚakɨƚ wɨñ mɨhöp alagnab magö u, ‘Yad Jisas nɨp nɨŋagpin,’ a gɨmön, ij mɨhau nɨgaŋ wai ñɨnabön,” a ga manö u nɨŋö, mög gö, mɨɫöŋ kub ga.
